qt: to the Commission Friedrich Pürner (NI), Jan-Peter Warnke (NI) Subject:
A number of media reports1 suggest that the Commission is planning to set up an EU intelligence service using data from Member States. 1.
Can the Commission please explain how such a service is compatible with the subsidiarity principle?
What is the legal basis for setting up such a service, and what scrutiny would it be subject to?
For what purpose would the Commission collect and use information from Member States?
